default.0f5c38f0-3c87-4a3e-858e-4f0bed97a4a1: The FormBuilder component is designed to dynamically generate forms based on an array of field configuration objects provided as a prop. This component simplifies the form creation process by allowing developers to define form fields declaratively. It iterates over each configuration object to render the appropriate FormInput components within a form container. Additionally, the FormBuilder component exposes a submitFormData variable, which can be utilized in the form submission workflow.
